# Portuguese Housekeeping Services

> Family-owned house cleaning company serving Toronto and Mississauga since 1994.

## Business Info

- Name: Portuguese Housekeeping Services
- Owner: Denise (30+ years)
- Phone: (905) 501-1509
- Address: 45 Kingsbridge Garden Circle, Suite #2007, Mississauga, ON L5R 3K4
- Website: https://portuguesemaids.ca
- Email: portuguesehousekeeping@gmail.com

## Services

- Standard house cleaning (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly)
- Deep cleaning
- Move-in and move-out cleaning
- Commercial cleaning
- Laundry and additional maid services (by request)

## Pricing

- $45 per hour for most residential projects
- 3-hour minimum per visit
- One-time, heavy commercial, or specialty jobs may cost more
- Payment: cash or e-transfer
- Clients provide their own cleaning supplies and equipment

## Service Areas

- All of Toronto (Downtown, Midtown, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, the Beaches, High Park, Yorkville, Leslieville, Roncesvalles)
- Central Mississauga (Port Credit, Streetsville, Erin Mills, Meadowvale, Square One, Cooksville, Clarkson, Lorne Park)

## How It Works

- Call Denise to describe your home, needs, and schedule
- She assigns a dedicated cleaner to your home
- Same cleaner every visit
- Cleaners are independent contractors vetted by Denise
- One week minimum notice to book
- Busier during holidays, spring cleaning, and March break

## Key Facts

- Never advertised. 100% referral-based growth for 30 years.
- Owner-operated. Denise personally knows every client.
- Same cleaner assigned to each home, every visit.
- Cleaners use the client's own supplies and equipment.
- Serving the Greater Toronto Area since 1994.
